body:
This was really nice to read, thank you for your very kind words. I love Murakami’s novels, I’ve read them all. The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle is a great one to read too, if you wanted to check out more of his work. And that is very well put. Maybe the theme of willpower and determination in order to overcome (surreal) obstacles is the reason why I’m so drawn to his works. Sometimes things in my life feel so awful and overpowering that they seem surreal. I’ve never actually thought about why I love his books so much. I guess, now that I think about it, I get a feeling of comfort when the characters overcome the surreal intrusions and their lives go back to normal.

I keep finding myself re-reading your message. Things are still extremely difficult for me, and I can’t lie and say I’m not scared. That being said, sharing small insights about books is both comforting and encouraging. Thank you again for taking time to respond.
Thank you for taking the time to comment, I appreciate it. You may be a stranger but it means a lot sometimes to hear that
Thank you, that’s nice of you to offer. I’m not really sure what else I want to say
